description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Windshield Wiper Blades Assemblies.
Attaches to the Wiper Arm Assemblies having a J-Hook Connector.
Comes with 12″ New Rubber Blades pre-installed.
Pre-Painted Flat Black
Note: Connects with the J-Hook Arm ONLY / Verify Prior to Ordering
Note: Measure your existing blades before ordering.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Windshield Wiper Assemblies
Qty 2 – Windshield Wiper Blades – 12″ Long
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki SJ413 Various Models
